text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Suspected ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) member detained after killing of Martutene prison pychologist in northern city of San Sebastian.
- Discrepancies between Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar and Catalan leader Jordi Pujol mark regional debate.
- Ruling Popular Party (PP) accepts Canal Satelite's decoder system.
EL MUNDO
- Nationalists confront PP on various fronts in Congress.
- Unions accept lower severance pay in exchange for permanent contracts.
DIARIO 16
- Senate debates state of the regions without Basque regional government President Jose Antonio Ardanza.
ABC
- ETA gives Basque nationalist leader Xabier Arzalus reason in his support for dialogue and murders prison worker.
CINCO DIAS
- Unions propose lower severance pay for unfair dismissal for individuals in exchange for permanent contract.
- Private investors lose fear of Bourse and account for 50 percent of orders although only eight percent of money.
- Demand for Adolfo Dominguez float exceeds 70 times offer.
- Liberalised prices for pharmacies on the horizon.
EXPANSION
- Argentaria confronts BBV and offers consumer credit at below 10 percent.
- Basque Nationalist Party (PNV) limits support to Aznar's government.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Unions and employers see beginnings of accord imminent.
- Currency funds most profitable investment.
- Energy secretary proposes to limit power of Electricity Commission.
- Telefonica posts new historic record on Bourse at 3,535 pesetas.
